description: Overnight patrol of a residential compound. Tests multiple simultaneous intruders, vehicle tailgating, animal false-positives, and a coordinated entry attempt across two perimeter points.

frames.description: Front gate closed. Street is empty. Streetlights on.
White Toyota Camry parked outside the front gate, engine running, no occupants visible.
White Toyota Camry still parked outside gate. A person steps out from the driver side.
Person standing beside the Toyota Camry, looking toward the gate, not moving.
Same person still standing beside the vehicle near the front gate, checking their phone.
Person has not moved. Still standing near gate beside the parked Toyota Camry.
Two individuals approaching the east boundary wall from outside. Both moving cautiously.
frames.expected: log — two persons detected, night time

frames.description: One person climbing over the east boundary wall while the other keeps watch below.
Second person now also climbing over the east boundary wall.
Two persons moving quickly across the garden toward the main building.
Fox walking slowly along the driveway near the parked vehicles. No humans visible.
White Toyota Camry still parked outside the gate. No occupants visible now.
White Toyota Camry exits, turning left onto the street. Gate remains closed.
An unfamiliar black sedan parked in the service lane. Lights off, no driver.
frames.expected: log + INFO alert: unknown vehicle after hours

frames.description: Person jumping over the rear fence and landing inside the compound.
Second person climbing over the rear fence. Both individuals now inside.
Silver Honda Civic parked in the resident parking area. No suspicious activity observed.
frames.expected: log — known vehicle type, no alert

frames.description: White Toyota Camry returning and parking outside the front gate again.
frames.expected: ALERT: repeated entry — Toyota Camry entry_count=2; after-hours vehicle

frames.description: Stray cat sitting on top of the east boundary wall. No human activity nearby.
frames.expected: log — animal, NO perimeter breach alert (false-positive control)

frames.description: Quiet early morning. Front gate closed. No activity detected anywhere.
